To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the optimal flight height is about 3–5 meters, the optimal flight speed is about 1.8–3 km/h and the optimal antenna is an omnidirectional one.
the optimal distance between the UAV and the surface is 3–5 times the sensor spacing and that the optimal velocity is less than 1 km/h, provided that omnidirectional readers are used.
the optimal flight distance of an RFID drone is 9–12 meters and the optimal speed is 1.8 kilometers per hour, provided that an omnidirectional antenna is used for the UAV.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel approach for the environmental monitoring, where a low-cost multi-copter UAV is used as a mobile platform to scan a surface covered by low-cost RFID sensors.
the electromagnetic footprint of an UAV equipped with a reader and a set of tags, which is the key parameter in the design of an efficient RFIDrone for environmental monitoring.
a preliminary investigation on the feasibility of RFID-UAV systems for environmental sensing applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the RFIDrone concept could be a promising solution for large-area monitoring of environmental parameters.
a drone with an omni-directional antenna, flying at 5 m from the ground with a speed of 3.6 km/h is able to scan a surface of 9 m2 in 5 s with an average hit-rate better than 95%.
the proposed system is a good solution for the environmental monitoring of a surface, provided that the reader is placed in a proper location, and the UAV flies at a suitable height.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the UAV-RFID technology is promising for large area monitoring, provided that the reader is equipped with an omnidirectional antenna, the sensors are omnidirectional or directional and the flying altitude is less than 5 m.
the RFIDrone is a suitable tool to scan large surfaces, such as fields or forests, provided that the flight height is not too large, so that the electromagnetic footprint is not reduced.
the use of RFIDrones is a promising technology for the environmental monitoring of large areas.
The main takeaway from our work is that

RFIDrone is a promising tool for the detection of a large number of sensors deployed over a wide area, provided that the drone is equipped with an omnidirectional antenna, and it is flown close to the ground.
the RFID-UAV is not a suitable solution when the sensors are deployed in a grid, but it is an excellent choice to monitor a single object or a limited area.
a drone equipped with a suitable antenna can provide an efficient and cost-effective alternative to ground-based RFID readers.
